0_0.l: alhamdulillahilladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur
0_0.t: All praise is for Allah who gives us life after He has caused us to die, and to Him is the resurrection.

1_0.l: alhamdulillahilladhi kasani hadha wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah
1_0.t: Praise be to Allah who has clothed me with this garment and provided it for me without any power or strength from me.
1_0.s: HR. all compilers of Sunan books, except Nasa'i

2_0.l: allahumma lakal-hamdu anta kasawtanihi. as'aluka min khayrihi wa khayri ma suni'a lah, wa a'udhu bika min sharrihi wa sharri ma suni'a lah
2_0.t: O Allah, to You is all praise. You have clothed me with this. I ask You for its goodness and the goodness for which it was made, and I seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil for which it was made.
2_0.s: HR. Ahmad, Abu Dawud, at-Tirmidzi and Al-Hakim

4_0.s: HR. al-Bukari No. 5376 and Muslim No. 2022

6_0.t: I ask for Your forgiveness (O Allah).

7_0.s: HR. al-Bukari No. 5376 and Muslim No. 2022

9_0.l: allahumma inni a'udhu bika an adilla aw udalla, aw azilla aw uzalla, aw adhlima aw udhlama, aw ajhala aw yujhala 'alayya
9_0.t: O Allah, I seek refuge in You lest I should stray or be led astray, slip or be tripped, wrong or be wronged, or act foolishly or have foolishness done to me.
9_0.s: HR. Abu Dawud, at-Tirmidzi, Ibn Majah and an-Nasa'i

9_1.l: bismillah, tawakkaltu 'alallah, la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
9_1.t: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah. There is no might nor power except with Allah.

24_1.l: la ilaha illa allah wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. allahumma la mani'a lima a'tayta wa la mu'tiya lima mana'ta wa la yanfa'u dhal-jaddi minkal-jaddu
24_1.t: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, He has no partner. To Him belongs dominion and praise, and He is over all things competent. O Allah, there is no preventer of what You give, and no giver of what You withhold, and wealth and honor do not benefit their possessor (except faith and righteous deeds that save from punishment). Only from You is wealth and honor.
24_1.s: HR. Bukhari No. 844 and Muslim No. 593

24_2.l: la ilaha illa allah wahdahu la sharika lah. lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah. la ilaha illa allah wa la na'budu illa iyyah. lahun-ni'mah wa lahul-fadl wa lahuth-thana'ul-hasan. la ilaha illa allah mukhlisina lahud-dina wa law karihal-kafirun
24_2.t: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, He has no partner. To Him belongs dominion and praise, and He is over all things competent. There is no power and no strength except by Allah. There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah, and we do not worship except Him. To Him belongs all favor, grace, and good praise. There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah, making our religion sincerely for Him, even if the disbelievers dislike it.

24_5.l: allahu la ilaha illa huwa, al-hayyul-qayyum. la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm. lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard. man dhal-ladhi yashfa'u 'indahu illa bi-idhnihi. ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum. wa la yuhituna bishay'in min 'ilmihi illa bima sha'. wa si'a kursiyyuhu as-samawati wal-ard. wa la ya'udu-hu hifdhuhuma. wa huwa al-'aliyyul-'azim
24_5.t: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
24_5.s: HR. an-Nasai in Al-Kubro 9: 44. This hadith is declared sahih by Ibn Hibban, as mentioned by Ibn Hajar in Bulugh al-Maram

26_1.l: allahu la ilaha illa huwa, al-hayyul-qayyum. la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm. lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard. man dhal-ladhi yashfa'u 'indahu illa bi-idhnihi. ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum. wa la yuhituna bishay'in min 'ilmihi illa bima sha'. wa si'a kursiyyuhu as-samawati wal-ard. wa la ya'udu-hu hifdhuhuma. wa huwa al-'aliyyul-'azim
26_1.t: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
26_1.s: HR. an-Nasai in Al-Kubro 9: 44. This hadith is declared sahih by Ibn Hibban, as mentioned by Ibn Hajar in Bulugh al-Maram

26_3.l: asbahna wa asbahal-mulku lillahi, wal-hamdu lillahi, la ilaha illa allah wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahu al-mulku wa lahu al-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. rabbi as'aluka khayra ma fi hadha al-yawm wa khayra ma ba'dahu, wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma fi hadha al-yawm wa sharri ma ba'dahu. rabbi a'udhu bika mina al-kasali wa su'il-kibar. rabbi a'udhu bika min 'adhabin fin-nar wa 'adhabin fil-qabr
26_3.t: We have entered the morning and the dominion belongs to Allah, and all praise is for Allah. There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, He has no partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him is praise, and He is over all things competent. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and the good of what follows it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil of what follows it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and the evil of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the Fire and the punishment of the grave.
26_3.s: HR. Muslim No. 2723 (75), Abu Dawud No. 5071, and at-Tirmidzi 3390, sahih from Abdullah Ibn Mas'ud

26_4.l: allahumma bika asbahna, wa bika amsayna, wa bika nahya, wa bika namutu wa ilaykan-nushur
26_4.t: O Allah, with Your grace and help we enter the morning, and with Your grace and help we enter the evening. By Your grace and will we live and by Your grace and will we die. And to You is the resurrection (for all creatures).
26_4.s: HR. al-Bukhari in al-Adab al-Mufrad No. 1199, this wording is the wording of al-Bukhari, at-Tirmidzi No. 3391, Abu Dawud No. 5068, Ahmad 11/354, Ibn Majah No. 3868

26_5.l: allahumma anta rabbi la ilaha illa anta khalaqtani wa ana 'abduka wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata'tu a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana'tu abu'u laka bini'matika 'alayya wa abu'u bidhanbi faghfir li fa innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa anta
26_5.t: O Allah, You are my Lord. There is no deity worthy of worship except You. You created me, and I am Your servant. I abide to Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your blessings upon me, and I acknowledge my sin. So forgive me, for none can forgive sins except You.
26_5.s: HR. al-Bukhari No. 6306, 6323, Ahmad IV/122-125, an-Nasa'i VIII/279-280

26_8.l: allahumma 'afini fi badani, allahumma 'afini fi sam'i, allahumma 'afini fi basari, la ilaha illa anta. allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-kufri wal-faqr, allahumma inni a'udhu bika min 'adhabil-qabr, la ilaha illa anta
26_8.t: O Allah, protect my body (from illness and from what I do not want). O Allah, protect my hearing (from illness and disobedience or from what I do not want). O Allah, protect my sight, there is no deity worthy of worship except You. O Allah, indeed I seek refuge in You from disbelief and poverty. I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, there is no deity worthy of worship except You.
26_8.s: HR. al-Bukhari in Sahih al-Adab al-Mufrad No. 701, Abu Dawud No. 5090, Ahmad V/42, hasan

26_10.l: allahumma inni as'alukal-'afwa wal-'afiyah fid-dunya wal-akhirah. allahumma inni as'alukal-'afwa wal-'afiyah fi dini wa dunyaya wa ahli wa mali. allahummastur 'awrati wa amin raw'ati. allahummahfadhni min bayni yadayya wa min khalfi wa 'an yamini wa 'an shimali wa min fawqi wa a'udhu bi 'adhamatika an ughtala min tahti
26_10.t: O Allah, indeed I ask You for well-being and safety in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, indeed I ask You for well-being and safety in my religion, my world, my family and my wealth. O Allah, cover my flaws (faults and things that are not appropriate for others to see) and calm me from fear. O Allah, protect me from the front, behind, right, left and above me. I seek refuge in Your greatness, so that I am not snatched from below me (by snakes or swallowed by the earth, etc., which would cause me to fall).
26_10.s: HR. al-Bukhari in al-Adab al-Mufrad No. 1200, Abu Dawud No. 5074, an-Nasa'i VII/282, Ibn Majah No. 3871, al-Hakim 1/517-518, and others from Ibn Umar radhiyallahu 'anhuma

26_11.l: allahumma 'alimal-ghaybi wash-shahadati, fatiras-samawati wal-ard, rabbakulli shayin wa malikahu. ashhadu alla ilaha illa anta, a'udhu bika min sharri nafsi, wa min sharri ash-shaytani wa shirkih. wa an aqtarifa 'ala nafsi su'an aw ajurrahu ila muslim
26_11.t: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Lord of all things and their Sovereign. I bear witness that there is no deity worthy of worship except You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of myself, Satan and his soldiers (temptations to commit shirk against Allah), and I (seek refuge in You) from committing evil against myself or dragging it to a Muslim.
26_11.s: HR. al-Bukhari in al-Adab al-Mufrad No. 1202, at-Tirmidzi No. 3392 and Abu Dawud No. 5067

26_12.l: bismillahilladhi la yadurru ma'asmihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama' wa huwas-sami'ul-'alim
26_12.t: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing in the earth or the heavens can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
26_12.s: HR. at-Tirmidzi No. 3388, Abu Dawud No. 5088, Ibn Majah No. 3869, al-Hakim 1/514, and Ahmad No. 446 and 474

26_13.l: raditu billahi rabba, wa bil-islami dina, wa bi-muhammadin sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallama nabiyya
26_13.t: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, Islam as my religion, and Muhammad, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, as my Prophet.
26_13.s: HR. Ahmad IV/337, Abu Dawud No. 5072, at-Tirmidzi No. 3389, Ibn Majah No. 3870, an-Nasa'i in 'Amalul Yaum wal Lailah No. 4 and Ibnus Sunni No. 68

26_14.l: ya hayyu ya qayyum, bi-rahmatika astaghith, wa aslih li sha'ni kullahu wa la takilni ila nafsi tarfata 'aynin abada
26_14.t: O Ever-Living, O Self-Sustaining, by Your mercy I seek help, rectify all my affairs and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.
26_14.s: HR. an-Nasa'i in 'Amalul Yaum wal Lailah No. 575, and al-Hakim 1/545, see Sahih at-Targhib wat Tarhib 1/417 No. 661, As-Sahihah No. 227, hasan

26_16.l: asbahna 'ala fitratil-islam wa 'ala kalimatil-ikhlas, wa 'ala dini nabiyyina muhammadin sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, wa 'ala millati abina ibrahima hanifan musliman wa ma kana minal-mushrikin
26_16.t: In the morning we are upon the fitrah of Islam, the word of sincerity (the testimony of faith), the religion of our Prophet Muhammad, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, and the religion of our father Abraham, who stood upon the straight path, a Muslim, and was not among the polytheists.
26_16.s: HR. Ahmad III/406, 407, ad-Darimi II/292 and Ibnus Sunni in Amalul Yaum wal Lailah No. 34, Mishkat al-Masabih No. 2415, Sahih al-Jami' as-Saghir No. 4674, sahih

26_17.t: Glory be to Allah, and praise be to Him.
26_17.s: HR. Muslim No. 2691 and No. 2692, from Abu Hurairah radhiyallahu 'anhu Sharh Muslim XVII/17-18, Sahih at-Targhib wat Tarhib 1/413 No. 653

26_18.l: la ilaha illa allah wahdahu la sharika lah. lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir
26_18.t: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, He has no partner. To Him belongs dominion and praise, and He is over all things competent.

26_19.l: la ilaha illa allah wahdahu la sharika lah. lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir
26_19.t: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, He has no partner. To Him belongs dominion and praise, and He is over all things competent.

26_20.l: subhanallahi wa bihamdihi 'adada khalqihi wa rida nafsihi wa zinata 'arshihi wa midada kalimatihi
26_20.t: Glory be to Allah, as many as His creations, Glory be to Allah as much as His pleasure, Glory be to Allah as much as the weight of His Throne, and as much as the ink of His written words.
26_20.s: HR. Muslim No. 2726. Sharh Muslim XVII/44. From Juwairiyah bint al-Harith radhiyallahu 'anha

26_21.l: allahumma inni as'aluka 'ilman nafi'an, wa rizqan tayyiban, wa 'amalan mutaqabbalan
26_21.t: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and accepted deeds.
26_21.s: HR. Ibn Majah No. 925 and Ahmad 6: 305, 322. Al-Hafiz Abu Tahir said that this hadith is sahih

26_22.t: I seek forgiveness from Allah and repent to Him.
26_22.s: HR. al-Bukhari/Fat-hul Baari XI/101 and Muslim No. 2702

27_1.l: allahu la ilaha illa huwa, al-hayyul-qayyum. la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm. lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard. man dhal-ladhi yashfa'u 'indahu illa bi-idhnihi. ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum. wa la yuhituna bishay'in min 'ilmihi illa bima sha'. wa si'a kursiyyuhu as-samawati wal-ard. wa la ya'udu-hu hifdhuhuma. wa huwa al-'aliyyul-'azim
27_1.t: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
27_1.s: HR. an-Nasai in Al-Kubro 9: 44. This hadith is declared sahih by Ibn Hibban, as mentioned by Ibn Hajar in Bulugh al-Maram

27_3.l: amsayna wa amsal-mulku lillahi wal-hamdu lillahi, la ilaha illa allah wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahu al-mulku wa lahu al-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. rabbi as'aluka khayra ma fi hadhihil-laylah wa khayra ma ba'daha, wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma fi hadhihil-laylah wa sharri ma ba'daha. rabbi a'udhu bika mina al-kasali wa su'il-kibar. rabbi a'udhu bika min 'adhabin fin-nar wa 'adhabin fil-qabr
27_3.t: We have entered the evening and the dominion belongs to Allah, and all praise is for Allah. There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, He has no partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him is praise, and He is over all things competent. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this night and the good of what follows it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this night and the evil of what follows it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and the evil of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the Fire and the punishment of the grave.
27_3.s: HR. Muslim No. 2723 (75), Abu Dawud No. 5071, and at-Tirmidzi 3390, sahih from Abdullah Ibn Mas'ud

27_4.l: allahumma bika amsayna, wa bika asbahna, wa bika nahya, wa bika namutu wa ilayka al-masir
27_4.t: O Allah, by Your grace and help we have entered the evening, and by Your grace and help we enter the morning. By Your grace and help we live and by Your will we die. And to You is the final return (of all creatures).
27_4.s: HR. al-Bukhari in al-Adab al-Mufrad No. 1199, this wording is the wording of al-Bukhari at-Tirmidzi No. 3391, Abu Dawud No. 5068, Ahmad 11/354, Ibn Majah No. 3868

27_5.l: allahumma anta rabbi la ilaha illa anta khalaqtani wa ana 'abduka wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata'tu a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana'tu abu'u laka bini'matika 'alayya wa abu'u bidhanbi faghfir li fa innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa anta
27_5.t: O Allah, You are my Lord. There is no deity worthy of worship except You. You created me, and I am Your servant. I abide to Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your blessings upon me, and I acknowledge my sin. So forgive me, for none can forgive sins except You.
27_5.s: HR. al-Bukhari No. 6306, 6323, Ahmad IV/122-125, an-Nasa'i VIII/279-280

27_8.l: allahumma 'afini fi badani, allahumma 'afini fi sam'i, allahumma 'afini fi basari, la ilaha illa anta. allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-kufri wal-faqr, allahumma inni a'udhu bika min 'adhabil-qabr, la ilaha illa anta
27_8.t: O Allah, protect my body (from illness and from what I do not want). O Allah, protect my hearing (from illness and disobedience or from what I do not want). O Allah, protect my sight, there is no deity worthy of worship except You. O Allah, indeed I seek refuge in You from disbelief and poverty. I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, there is no deity worthy of worship except You.
27_8.s: HR. al-Bukhari in Sahih al-Adab al-Mufrad No. 701, Abu Dawud No. 5090, Ahmad V/42, hasan

27_10.l: allahumma inni as'alukal-'afwa wal-'afiyah fid-dunya wal-akhirah. allahumma inni as'alukal-'afwa wal-'afiyah fi dini wa dunyaya wa ahli wa mali. allahummastur 'awrati wa amin raw'ati. allahummahfadhni min bayni yadayya wa min khalfi wa 'an yamini wa 'an shimali wa min fawqi wa a'udhu bi 'adhamatika an ughtala min tahti
27_10.t: O Allah, indeed I ask You for well-being and safety in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, indeed I ask You for well-being and safety in my religion, my world, my family and my wealth. O Allah, cover my flaws (faults and things that are not appropriate for others to see) and calm me from fear. O Allah, protect me from the front, behind, right, left and above me. I seek refuge in Your greatness, so that I am not snatched from below me (by snakes or swallowed by the earth, etc., which would cause me to fall).
27_10.s: HR. al-Bukhari in al-Adab al-Mufrad No. 1200, Abu Dawud No. 5074, an-Nasa'i VII/282, Ibn Majah No. 3871, al-Hakim 1/517-518, and others from Ibn Umar radhiyallahu 'anhuma

27_11.s: HR. al-Bukhari in al-Adab al-Mufrad No. 1202, at-Tirmidzi No. 3392 and Abu Dawud No. 5067

27_12.t: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing in the earth or the heavens can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
27_12.s: HR. at-Tirmidzi No. 3388, Abu Dawud No. 5088, Ibn Majah No. 3869, al-Hakim 1/514, and Ahmad No. 446 and 474

27_13.t: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, Islam as my religion, and Muhammad, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, as my Prophet.

27_16.t: In the evening we are upon the fitrah of Islam, the word of sincerity (the testimony of faith), the religion of our Prophet Muhammad, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, and the religion of our father Abraham, who stood upon the straight path, a Muslim, and was not among the polytheists.

27_17.t: Glory be to Allah, and praise be to Him.
27_17.s: HR. Muslim No. 2691 and No. 2692, from Abu Hurairah radhiyallahu 'anhu Sharh Muslim XVII/17-18, Sahih at-Targhib wat Tarhib 1/413 No. 653

27_18.t: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, He has no partner. To Him belongs dominion and praise, and He is over all things competent.

27_19.t: I seek forgiveness from Allah and repent to Him.
27_19.s: HR. al-Bukhari/Fat-hul Baari XI/101 and Muslim No. 2702

27_20.t: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
27_20.s: HR. Ahmad 11/290, an-Nasa'i in 'Amalul Yaum wal Lailah No. 596, Sahih at-Targhib wat Tarhib 1/412 No. 652, Sahih al-Jami' as-Saghir No. 6427

28_6.t: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

28_12.l: allahumma 'alimal-ghaybi wash-shahadati, fatiras-samawati wal-ard, rabbakulli shayin wa malikahu. ashhadu alla ilaha illa anta, a'udhu bika min sharri nafsi, wa min sharri ash-shaytani wa shirkih. wa an aqtarifa 'ala nafsi su'an aw ajurrahu ila muslim

41_0.l: allahummakfini bi halalika 'an haramik, wa aghnini bi fadlika 'amman siwak
41_0.t: O Allah, suffice me with what is lawful and keep me away from what is unlawful, and enrich me with Your bounty so I do not depend on anyone besides You.

43_0.l: allahumma la sahla illa ma ja'altahu sahla, wa anta taj'alul-hazna idha shi'ta sahla
43_0.t: O Allah, there is no ease except in that which You make easy, and You make the difficult easy if You wish.

53_0.l: inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un. allahumma'jurni fi musibati wa akhlif li khayran minha
53_0.t: Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we will return. O Allah, reward me for my affliction and replace it with something better.

61_0.l: allahumma inni as'aluka khayraha wa a'udhu bika min sharriha
61_0.t: O Allah, I ask You for the good of this wind, and I seek refuge in You from its evil.
61_0.s: HR. Abu Dawud and Ibn Majah

64_0.t: O Allah, make it a beneficial rain.

65_0.t: We have been given rain by the bounty and mercy of Allah.
65_0.s: HR. al-Bukhari No. 846 and Muslim No. 71

66_0.l: allahumma hawalayna wa la 'alayna. allahumma 'alal-akami wadh-dhirabi, wa butunil-awdiyati, wa manabitish-shajar
66_0.t: O Allah, (let the rain fall) around us, not on us. O Allah, (let it fall) on the hills, mountains, small mountains, valleys, and places where trees grow.

68_0.l: dhahabadh-dhama'u wabtallatil-'uruqu wa thabatal-ajru insha allah
68_0.t: The thirst has gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is confirmed, Insha Allah.
68_0.s: HR. Abu Daud, As-Sunan Al-Kubra Lil Baihaqi, Vol. 4, p. 239, al-Hakim in Mustadrak 'alas Shahihain No. 1484

70_0.l: alhamdulillahilladhi at'amani hadha wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah
70_0.t: All praise is to Allah who has fed me this and provided for me without any power or strength from me.

78_0.t: May Allah guide you and improve your condition.

99_0.s: HR. al-Bukari No. 5376 and Muslim No. 2022

101_0.l: astawdi'ullaha dinaka, wa amanataka, wa khawatima 'amalik
101_0.t: I entrust your religion, your trust, and the end of your deeds to Allah.

101_1.l: zawwadakallahut-taqwa, wa ghafara dhanbaka, wa yassara lakal-khayra haythuma kunta
101_1.t: May Allah provide you with piety, forgive your sins, and ease goodness for you wherever you are.

104_0.l: a'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq
104_0.t: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
104_0.s: HR. Ahmad 11/290, an-Nasa'i in 'Amalul Yaum wal Lailah No. 596, Sahih at-Targhib wat Tarhib 1/412 No. 652, Sahih al-Jami' as-Saghir No. 6427

117_0.l: rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina 'adhaban-nar
117_0.t: Our Lord! Give us good in this world and give us good in the Hereafter, and save us from the torment of the hell fire.
